## Checklist (Definition of Done)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria met (link FR)
- [ ] Unit + integration tests added and passing
- [ ] e2e test added/updated if a user journey changed
- [ ] Permission + project-scope cases tested (403/404), server-side
- [ ] Lock-date, approval and idempotency behaviour covered where relevant
- [ ] Migration included and reversible-by-design (expand/contract)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, logs or fixtures
- [ ] OpenAPI / CHANGELOG / runbook updated
- [ ] Sensitive area (auth, permissions, posting, numbering, GST)? → reviewer did a line-by-line review
